suppress.notes: False positive. CVE-2022-31691 affects the Spring Tools 4 IDE extensions (Eclipse <= 4.16.0, VSCode Spring Boot Tools <= 1.39.0), not the spring-boot-devtools library. It matches only through the generic cpe:vmware:spring_tools, whose version range contains 4.2.0. devtools is also excluded from the production jar. Recorded in docs/plans/2026-11-22-java25-spring-boot4-evidence.md.
